reader.requirement: When several argument-1 of FUNCTION MAX share the greatest value under the simple-condition comparison (including equal-after-space-padding alphanumeric operands and characters an ALPHABET ALSO makes equal in the program collating sequence), the content returned is that of the leftmost such argument-1, with ALL-subscript arguments expanded in their left-to-right order.

edition-consulted.switches: the function's IntroducedIn (85 for MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN) against DialectLevel: COBOL1502 before it
ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year) selects which argument predicates are asked; the class screen, not the returned-value path
construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands is refused (COBOL0900); inside an arithmetic expression it is not consulted
OPTIONS ARITHMETIC mode; at 85 no ARITHMETIC clause exists so Options.Arithmetic is Native, the latest edition's default arm

reader.edition-search: grep of Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior over IntrinsicRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs, CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs, CobolIntrinsics.Dec.cs, CobolIntrinsics.ExactValue.cs and CobolTable.cs found none on the MAX/MEAN/MEDIAN arms; the edition is read only in IntrinsicBinder (availability window, identifier-placement screen, argument predicates) and through the arithmetic mode
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf39_03 covers alphanumeric literal and item ties of unequal size; not exercised there are ties under a PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE with ALSO, ALL-subscript and ODO arguments, group and alphabetic/alphanumeric mixed ties, and reference-modified arguments (probed here)

probes.expected: each tie returns the leftmost argument at its own size (A3 W-A size 3, A4 W-X size 5, A5 G size 2, A9 ODO group size 3, AA ODO group size 5, AB/AC leftmost ref-mod); numeric extremes and size error correct
ALPHABET ALPH IS "A" ALSO "B" ALSO "C": A=B=C, so MAX(B A)=B, MAX(A B)=A, MAX(C(2) B A)="C ", MAX(A D C)=D
ALL with ref-mod per element B,A,C all equal -> B; ODO table N=2 C,B -> C; W-M first -> "B  "; SPACE above A in ALPH -> " "; ALL "B" equal to A -> leftmost A

probes.printed: COBOL0900 floating-point numeric literal 1.5E1 requires COBOL-2002 (lines 9, 11, 12); COBOL0900 national literal N"AB" requires COBOL-2002 plus COBOL1627 class mismatch (line 10)
probes.expected: a later edition's floating-point and national literals are refused at --std 85

reader.notes: ExtremeIndex keeps the first index and replaces it only on a strictly greater compare, through CobolString.Compare or the PCS collation, so ties keep the leftmost; MaxScaled's numeric ties are value-identical. The same programs print identically at --std 2023 (diff of the run outputs).
